name: application-data-usage-ring
title: Data Usage Ring
description: Circular data-usage ring components showing GB used versus plan limit with a days-left billing-cycle projection.
useWhen: Circular data-usage ring components showing GB used versus plan limit with a days-left billing-cycle projection.
avoidWhen: Avoid data usage ring when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Data Usage Ring uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
